provenance.clerk_text: Filed 45 years of monthly temperature (Temperature at 2 Meters, degC) for Niamey, Niger (Sahel), 1981-01 to 2025-12, averaged over 9 points. Source: NASA POWER Monthly & Annual API, accessed 2026-11-14.

verdict.label: moderate
verdict.reason: The trend is significant (p = 0.016 < 0.05), but p is not below 0.01 as Strong requires and the window agreement check failed.
